title: 3 Reasons to Route Agent Tasks to Gemini 3.5 Flash, Not Claude
description:
Gemini 3.5 Flash went GA on May 19 and it beats Google's own Pro on agent benchmarks. For a Claude Code user, the question is when to route a task off Claude — and these are the three reasons it's worth it.

1. Price — $1.50 in / $9 out per 1M tokens, roughly a third of an Opus agent loop.
2. Tool use — ~84% on the MCP tool-calling benchmark, past Claude Opus 4.7.
3. Routing — send tool-heavy planning to Flash, keep repo edits on Claude Code.

The catch: Flash defaults to high reasoning on every call, quietly inflating cost 30-50% on long agent loops. Turn the thinking level down to low and you get the price you were promised.

🔗 Full breakdown: https://avinashsangle.com/blog/gemini-3-5-flash-agentic-coding-guide
